description.value: Konbiniya Japan Centre is a Japanese convenience store operating in Vancouver since 1991, specializing in Japanese foods, snacks, drinks, and everyday supplies at its flagship Robson Street location. It also operates an in-store Bon Crepe counter offering Japanese-style crepes, soft serve, and corn dogs. The store has a second location in Kerrisdale and an online shop, and is known for stocking a curated selection of Japanese imported goods.
